scope: H5 locus only; queries must be coding-strand sequences with the specified Blon identifiers. This is not a general glycan-use classifier.

provenance.origin: Previously inspected cohort H5 exploratory assembly/readback audit, deep20261008; existing material is development evidence, not independent validation.
provenance.anchor_geometry: Reference left anchor is Blon_2174 and right anchor is Blon_2178. Both coding queries are minus-strand relative to the reference; reversing a contig swaps physical left/right anchor labels.
provenance.quality_filters: MAPQ/baseQ 20 and uninterrupted 20-bp flanks describe conditional read evidence. They do not establish species uniqueness, functional phenotype, or a calibrated positive/negative classifier.
provenance.mapping_version_change: v2 uses Bowtie2 default best-alignment reporting, without -k or -a, and excludes unknown MAPQ255. Earlier k5 MAPQ>=20 summaries included 255; those are preserved separately and are not validated high-confidence mapping evidence. See h5_k5_audit_v1.json for explicit multialignment audit mode.
